chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Abi Ali ibn Ghiyath, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, who said:

Yazid ibn Abdullah made a bequest of an animal, a sword, and wealth. The price of the animal and other than that was sent, but the sword was not sent. Then there came: 'There was, along with what you sent, a sword, but it did not arrive,' or as he said.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: made a bequest or testamentary instruction
key_terms.دَابَّةٍ: an animal included as part of the bequest
key_terms.سَيْفٍ: a sword that was supposed to be sent
key_terms.مَالٍ: wealth or property included in the bequest

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith from al-Kafi say about the missing sword in the bequest of Yazid ibn Abdullah?
ai.summary: This report relates a bequest that included an animal, a sword, and wealth, and notes that although the price of the animal and other items was sent, the sword was missing. A communication then arrived indicating awareness that a sword should have been included but had not reached its destination, reflecting the transmission of details concerning entrusted property.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Abu Ali Bin Giyas, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan who said,

‘Yazeed Bin Abdullah bequeathed with an animal, and a sword and some wealth. The price of the animal and other than that was sent across, and the sword was not sent. So there came (a letter from the 12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>): ‘It was so that along with whatever you sent, there was a sword, and it has not arrived’, or said like that’.
en.sarwar: 22. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu Ali ibn Ghiyath from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan who has said the following.

“ Yazid ibn ‘Abdallah has said in his will to sent a horse, a sword and certain other properties to holy location (office of the Imam (a.s.). The money from the sale of the horse and other properties were delivered to the holy location but the sword was forgotten. A message then came that said, “With the items that you sent there was a sword that has not reached us.” Or the message was in similar words.”
